column1: # Reviewed public corpus; generated without reading any machine account or Git identity.
# All channel-name field lines, plus card lines containing an ASCII word of 4+ letters
# from that channel name (case-insensitive, bounded by non-ASCII-letters).
# Relative path, TAB, SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 line without LF.
# Only the name test is exempt. Home paths and addresses are always checked.
